verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26144355 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318747 (dated 2026-09-25). It confirms one line: 25,000 pcs of PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6 at 25.62 CNY each, confirmed for 2026-12-01. Terms are FOB Yantian, NET30. The supplier notes that lid magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 per box) are fitted in its plant and included in the price.
observations: Single-page printed document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date of its own. The only date besides the confirmed delivery date is the order date.
Unit of measure for quantity is not stated. Currency is CNY.
The line total is not shown.
